publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.19 fixes local archive transfer for installations with owner migrations. Restore replays those migrations in the order recorded in the archive. Open the link printed by rer dev --as PERSONA within 15 minutes to sign in to the selected account in a fresh browser. Plain rer dev supplies the checkout-wide link that lets you switch between people. Use rer dev --as signed-out to open without a session. This upgrade uses the exact @runeditrun/rer 0.2.125 pin. There are 91 SQL migration files before and after. Every 0.5.18 migration is byte-identical, and zero migration files or required settings were added. Monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are retained on upgrade. Back up first through Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup if applicable. For local CLI backup, stop dev and run rer export --output exports/uptime.rer with the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE described in the backup guide. Keep it private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, stop dev or preview and deploy as usual. Keep the deployment receipt and use the existing installation keys for this upgrade. The mail enable/disable commands and legacy SendGrid selector guidance under 0.5.16 still apply. Earlier upgrade cautions still apply, including older heartbeat output, UptimeRobot monitor CSV import, restoration of the erased-people list, empty company decision feeds, the 64 KiB response-body limit, and large-scale archive operation that has yet to be established. Pingdom TMS scripts and recordings, Page Speed, relationships and history remain unconverted. Live account cutover and managed geographic equivalence have yet to be established. Imported definitions stay paused and credentials need local re-entry. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png, captured on 0.4.0. — Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-20.
